metadata.title: That 1 kill where Valorant was like ‘Wait, you got a kill?’ and I blinked twice
metadata.description:
Wait, how did I even click that?
Enemy probably pressed pause and left.
Valorant logic handing out mystery kills again.
Click if your aim’s mostly a wild guess!

Tap if your kills are more surprise than skill!

#valorant #gamingfails #luckshot #funnygaming #shorts
